title: polyosma fragrans
intro: Polyosma fragrans, commonly known as the Fragrant Woodlanders or Polyosma, is a species of flowering plant in the family Cunoniaceae. This plant is native to New Zealand and is known for its attractive foliage and fragrant white flowers. The leaves and flowers of Polyosma fragrans have been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health conditions, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues and promote wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Polyosma fragrans include its antimicrobial, antioxidant, and anti-inflammatory properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins.
